description: Recent earthquakes worldwide from the USGS: filter by minimum magnitude, period (hour|day|week|month) and optional radius around lat/lon (km). Returns magnitude, place, time, depth, tsunami flag and USGS link. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
